SELECT TYI.PROJECTID, TYI.PROJECTNAME, count(1) NUMBERCOUNT, sum(TYI.MONEY) SUMMONEY, sum(TYI.ZJJJCGJE) SUMZJJJCGJE, sum(YSNR.YSCLR) SUMYSCLR
FROM TBL_YQNS_ISSUE_LIST TYI LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TYIR.RECORDID, TYIR.ISSUESID, TYIR.VERSION, TYIR.WTZGID FROM TBL_YQNS_ISSUESRECORD TYIR JOIN ( SELECT ISSUESID, MAX(VERSION) AS VERSION FROM TBL_YQNS_ISSUESRECORD GROUP BY ISSUESID ) TYIRV ON TYIR.ISSUESID = TYIRV.ISSUESID AND TYIR.VERSION = TYIRV.VERSION ) TYIRR ON TYIRR.ISSUESID = TYI.ID LEFT JOIN TBL_YQNS_SJZG_WTZG TYSW ON TYIRR.WTZGID = TYSW.WTZGID LEFT JOIN TBL_YQNS_SJZG_YSNR YSNR ON TYSW.YSNRID = YSNR.YSNRID WHERE 1 = 1 AND TO_CHAR(TYI.ADDTIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') LIKE '${queryYear}%' GROUP BY TYI.PROJECTID, TYI.PROJECTNAME
